integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard Euler-product and zeta identities; finite code checks the parameterized exact counting identity and examples, not the infinite asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive parameter m only; count of all graph edges, not maximal independent-set density; no second-order constant. Earlier exact finite values appear in OEIS A362931 and A055081; earlier unindexed asymptotic formulas cannot be ruled out.
title: The exact logarithmic edge constant for reciprocal-mean divisibility graphs
